Green14.W_3_21_eq.reason: The aiXiv entry indexes an unrefereed Zenodo PDF (Nahmias, Oct 2026) claiming W(3,21)=416 via an AI pipeline. The Lean theorem takes the unsatisfiability of about 38.7 million SAT leaf formulas as hypotheses, checked outside the kernel by cake_lpr. The Zenodo record contains only the PDF: no certificates, CNFs or Lean development are public, and no independent reproduction exists, so the claim cannot be verified.
